_doc: Example spec for render_set.py. Paths are relative to this file. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Headline emphasis: wrap words in *asterisks*; \n forces a line break. Layouts: device (default), zoom, full, poster. Sizes: see render_set.py --presets.

style._doc_font: path to the brand .ttf/.otf; null = first installed sans (the report says which)
style._doc_case: none | upper (Turkish-safe when lang is tr)
style._doc_emphasis: style: color | box (color, text_color) | marker (color) | font (font: path to italic/bold file)
style._doc_device: width = fraction of canvas width; radius/border = fraction of device width; bleed lets the device run off the bottom
